status: Frozen before Phase 11 production: exploratory measurement and ensemble sensitivity, not efficacy validation

descriptor.primary: Unique water counts at 0.20,0.25,0.30,0.35,0.40,0.45,0.50 nm; nearest-solute-atom distance per water, equal-frame conditional PDF over [0,0.5] nm
descriptor.selection: All solute atoms including hydrogens; solvent oxygen only; each water counted once
descriptor.normalization: 100 bins, width 0.005 nm; each frame normalized by its in-range water count and bin width, then arithmetic mean over frames; inclusive count cutoffs, bins left closed/right open except final right closed
descriptor.rationale: Explicit local water occupancy interpretation coherent with cumulative counts, not chosen as proof of published-method reproduction; Phase 10 alternatives remain preserved
descriptor.secondary: Phase 10 all-pairs conditional PDF retained for sensitivity; no radial PCF normalization and no source-model substitution
descriptor.original_settings: Unresolved; original DOLMEN generator/mode/frame averaging cannot be established from inspected public sources

design.comparison: Same preparation seed and duration in both ensembles; NPT changes volume and effective concentration. Different compounds remain unmatched in size.

diagnostics.interpretation: Engineering stability flags chosen before production, not validated physical convergence criteria. Report every seed, effect sizes, block values and stride sensitivity. No automatic expansion to candidate screening if unresolved flags.
diagnostics.replicate_unit: Seed, never individual frame; ensemble contrasts paired by preparation seed but trajectories diverge.

outcomes: Versioned, tested hydration measurement; quantitative density/ensemble/time sensitivity; proceed or defer recommendation. No new activity labels, fitted model or cell-protection claims.
